subject: prd/docgate
statement: §0 and all of its subsections remain human-only: no docgate contract-unit parser, fold comparison, source-map projection, or gate verdict treats an ID-looking row anywhere in that subtree as an addressable unit
rationale: read-to-rule routing prose binds nothing and automated consumers are contractually forbidden to read, cite, or obey it
fit_criterion: the complete prd-template/v2 §0 fixture, including exact and slash-joined live IDs under §0 and §0.1, contributes zero units and cannot shadow a binding row with the same ID
